svg.title: 10c New requisition
svg.text: Requested by you: your department and office come from your account.

g.text: e.g. Projector and screen for training room 2
Why it is needed, and for whom

svg.text: Choose a budget line to see what is left
A requisition can't go over the line's available amount
Worked out from the value when you submit

g.text: Whoever raises a requisition can't approve any of its steps.
